title: clearance-reads-a-notified-file-as-covered
intention: harbor_master's PROVED rung reads a hollow reading value {"notified": <notice id>} as covered, so a file the tester has sent to the operator no longer refuses PROVED, while an empty list, an unreadable reading, an empty reading and a marker that names no notice still refuse.
why: The tester will send a revert the proofs cannot see to the operator instead of redding it (Akien, open-ed0a56ce6357: complete AND notify). The PROVED rung reads the seal; until it knows the notified marker it would refuse the very crossing Akien ruled must complete.
traces_to: df05d93da4c0's falsifier (a) and Akien's answer to open-ed0a56ce6357 ("we let it complete AND notify me"); RULE 1 (the change stays inside harbor_master; the tester's marker is read off the seal, a record, never by reaching into the tester); Law 8's escape route: his answered question is the decision in the same act
how: In cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/clearance.py hollow_lacks: before the unreadable census, collect the files whose reading is a dict with a non-empty string under 'notified'; exclude them from unreadable; the empty-list (hollow_file) and the empty-reading (hollow_nothing_measured) branches stay as they are. The docstring's value list gains the fourth value with the citation. A new proof beside clearance, test_a_notified_file_is_covered.py, drives hollow_lacks through its seal_reader parameter with fake seals: one notified file beside a covered file yields no lack; [] still reds hollow_file; {'unreadable': [...]} still reds hollow_unreadable; {'notified': ''} and {'notified': None} red hollow_unreadable; {} reds hollow_nothing_measured.
falsifier: 1: hollow_lacks over a code-seam whose reading is {'a.py': [tooth], 'b.py': {'notified': 'n-1'}} returns []. 2: the hard refusals stand — {'b.py': []} gives exactly hollow_file naming b.py; {'b.py': {'unreadable': ['p']}} gives exactly hollow_unreadable; {'b.py': {'notified': ''}} and {'b.py': {'notified': None}} give exactly hollow_unreadable naming b.py; {} gives exactly hollow_nothing_measured. RED if a notified file refuses, or if any of the four hard readings stops refusing. WRONG INTENT if Akien rules a notified file should hold the ticket. Horizon: this child PROVED.
watchme: none, because the live consumer is the PROVED rung itself on every code-seam crossing, and the producer's rate is the tester child's `notices` verb (parent df05d93da4c0's watchme: CairnCommons/tickets/df05d93da4c0-an-unvouched-green-completes-and-notifies.json)
children: none, because the change is one predicate in hollow_lacks and one proof
builder_notes: A Haiku builder needs: (1) the exact edit in clearance.py hollow_lacks, replacing the line `unreadable = sorted(f for f, r in reading.items() if not isinstance(r, list))` with: `notified = {f for f, r in reading.items() if isinstance(r, dict) and isinstance(r.get("notified"), str) and r["notified"].strip()}` then `unreadable = sorted(f for f, r in reading.items() if not isinstance(r, list) and f not in notified)`, with a comment citing df05d93da4c0 and open-ed0a56ce6357; and one bullet added to the docstring's value list: the key is present and names a NOTIFIED file -> covered (the tester sent the unvouched revert to the operator; Akien, open-ed0a56ce6357). (2) The proof at cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/proofs/test_a_notified_file_is_covered.py: _REPO_ROOT = parents[6]; PROVES = {'0069ce6b8681': {'1': 'test_a_notified_file_is_covered', '2': 'test_the_hard_refusals_stand'}}; a helper that returns a seal_reader lambda yielding {'evidence': {'hollow': {tid: reading}}}; a ticket dict {'id': tid, 'node_class': 'code-seam'}; named = ['proofs/fake.py']; resolve hollow_lacks at call time (from ...clearance import hollow_lacks inside each test); main() prints ok/FAIL per tooth, GREEN or RED (n failed), exit 0 only when green. (3) Run test_clearance.py after the build: it must stay green.

chart_claim.filled_by: CC chart chain (orient 081cbc2276d9 .. validate 1a3d09bad17d, each learned)

decisions.text: D1: SETTLED: write the proof FIRST, red, at cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/proofs/test_a_notified_file_is_covered.py. Header: _REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[6], inserted on sys.path. PROVES = {'0069ce6b8681': {'1': 'test_a_notified_file_is_covered', '2': 'test_the_hard_refusals_stand'}}. Helper _lacks(reading): clearance = importlib.import_module('cairn.devices.cairn.machines.harbor_master.clearance') AT CALL TIME (so reverting clearance.py reds a tooth instead of breaking the import); seal_reader = lambda path, artifact=False: {'evidence': {'hollow': {'0069ce6b8681': reading}}}; return clearance.hollow_lacks({'id': '0069ce6b8681', 'node_class': 'code-seam'}, ['cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/proofs/test_clearance.py'], repo_root=_REPO_ROOT, seal_reader=seal_reader). Tooth 1: {'a.py': ['test_x'], 'b.py': {'notified': 'notice-0123abcd'}} -> []. Tooth 2, by sorted lack kinds: {'a.py': []} -> ['hollow_file']; {'a.py': {'unreadable': ['p.py']}} -> ['hollow_unreadable']; {'notified': ''}, {'notified': '   '} and {'notified': None} each -> ['hollow_unreadable']; {} -> ['hollow_nothing_measured']; {'a.py': [], 'b.py': {'notified': 'notice-1'}} -> ['hollow_file']. main() runs each PROVES tooth, prints '  ok   <name>' or '  FAIL <name>: <exc>', then GREEN or RED, exit 1 on any fail. Before the edit: tooth 1 FAILS, tooth 2 passes.

D2: SETTLED: the edit in hollow_lacks (clearance.py), replacing the one line 'unreadable = sorted(f for f, r in reading.items() if not isinstance(r, list))' with: notified = {f for f, r in reading.items() if isinstance(r, dict) and isinstance(r.get('notified'), str) and r['notified'].strip()} and unreadable = sorted(f for f, r in reading.items() if not isinstance(r, list) and f not in notified). Above it a comment citing df05d93da4c0 and Akien's answer to open-ed0a56ce6357 (an unvouched green completes AND notifies; the tester seals the file as {'notified': <notice id>}). Nothing else in the function changes: the empty-list (hollow_file), empty-reading (hollow_nothing_measured) and absent-reading branches are untouched.

D3: SETTLED: hollow_lacks' docstring already carries a bulleted list of reading outcomes ('the key is ABSENT', 'names a hollow FILE', 'names an UNREADABLE file', 'every measured file redded a tooth -> covered'). Insert one bullet before the last: '- the key is present and a file reads {"notified": <notice id>} -> covered: the tester found the revert unseen by any tooth and sent it to the operator (ticket df05d93da4c0, Akien's answer to open-ed0a56ce6357: complete AND notify). A blank or null id is not a notice and reads unreadable.'

D4: SETTLED: after the edit run python3 cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/proofs/test_a_notified_file_is_covered.py (both teeth ok) AND python3 cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/proofs/test_clearance.py (must stay green: no regression in the existing hollow teeth). Then seal with bin/cairn test <proof> --seal, cross PROVEME, run bin/cairn test --hollow 0069ce6b8681 --seal (reverting clearance.py must red tooth 1).

D3 (confirmed by measurement 2026-10-04, clearance.py lines 641-673): the docstring's bulleted list opens with exactly these four bullets, in this order, each beginning '  - the key is': (1) 'the key is ABSENT  -> red', (2) 'the key is present and names a hollow FILE -> red', (3) 'the key is present and names an UNREADABLE file -> red' (a long bullet ending '...and then take the reading again.'), (4) 'the key is present and every measured file redded a tooth -> covered.' The new notified bullet goes between (3) and (4).

D4 (the mechanism, settled): nothing advances on its own except codemother's auto-PROVED on a green seal at PROVEME. The builder crosses BUILDME->PROVEME with the clearance door, then runs the hollow, then crosses PROVEME->PROVED through clearance.clear, naming proven_by=cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/proofs/test_a_notified_file_is_covered.py with a verdict written under the ticket. The PROVED rung itself reads the seal, the PROVES coverage and the hollow reading.
